facts: Olivia Residences is a gated scheme of 13 villas in Pernera, in the northern part of Protaras, Famagusta district; the scheme mixes detached three-bedroom villas and semi-detached two-bedroom villas.
The scheme is under construction; the price list gives the villa on sale (H11) at the tiling stage.
The Type A detached villa has three bedrooms, 136.65 m² of internal area (65.15 m² ground floor, 71.50 m² first floor) and 20.35 m² of covered verandas; H11 sits on a 272 m² plot.
Plots across the scheme range from about 193 m² to 353 m².
Each villa has its own 8 x 3 m skimmer pool, 1.40 m deep, with glass mosaic finish, in a walled garden with terrace.

The developer states Marlita Beach is about 700 m away (780 m on the aerial), Polyxenia Beach 800 m, Pernera Beach 850 m, restaurants and shops 300 m, supermarkets 500 m, Protaras centre 1.4 km, the marina 2.5 km and Larnaca airport 45 km.
Interiors have large-format porcelain tiles (Rodano dark grey 60x120), porcelain-slab kitchen worktops, soft-close laminate kitchen units and wall-hung WCs.
Specification includes a photovoltaic system, EV-charging provision, CAT6 cabling, air-conditioning provision in all rooms and an A energy performance certificate.
